name: sarcolemma associated protein

function.text: SLMAP encodes sarcolemmal membrane-associated protein. Annotated molecular activities include protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. It participates in muscle contraction and negative regulation of hippo signaling.

function.text: SLMAP encodes sarcolemmal membrane-associated protein. Based in part on similarity, it associates with the striatin-interacting phosphatase and kinase (STRIPAK) core complex, forming the extended (SIKE1:SLMAP)STRIPAK complex. The (SIKE1:SLMAP)STRIPAK complex dephosphorylates STK3 leading to the inhibition of Hippo signaling and the control of cell growth. May play a role during myoblast fusion.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SLMAP have been reported in kinase-altered spindle cell neoplasm (non-NTRK), malignant.
